versions.subject: Merge PR #5811 from @swachchhanda000 - Add New Vulnerable Driver Blocklist and HVCI Tampering Based Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
          - '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
          - 'reg.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'add '
        - 'New-ItemProperty '
        - 'Set-ItemProperty '
        - 'si '  # SetItem Alias
selection_cli_base:
    CommandLine|contains: '\DeviceGuard'
selection_cli_key:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity'
        - 'HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\reg.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "reg.exe") CommandLine IN ("*add *", "*New-ItemProperty *", "*Set-ItemProperty *", "*si *") CommandLine="*\\DeviceGuard*" CommandLine IN ("*EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity*", "*HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity*")
